mapper.select: SELECT f.follow_id AS follow_id, u.user_id AS user_id, u.nickname AS nickname, u.img_url AS avatar_url, u.account_level AS account_level, u.fans AS fans_count, u.follows AS follow_count, f.follow_date AS follow_date, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM follows f2 WHERE f2.follower_id = u.user_id AND f2.followed_id = #{userId} AND f2.enable = 1) AS mutual_follow FROM follows f INNER JOIN users u ON f.followed_id = u.user_id WHERE f.follower_id = #{userId} AND f.enable = 1 ORDER BY f.follow_date DESC
